amenitiesDescription:
Cipriani Residences carries the full weight of the brand's service tradition across every amenity level. The elevated resort deck features two swimming pools, an outdoor spa, private cabanas, and a landscaped sun terrace, all with poolside food and beverage by Cipriani. Private dining rooms are reservable on demand.

A four-level wellness center and lounge overlooks the Brickell skyline, with a spa with sauna and treatment rooms, a fitness center, pickleball court, and golf simulator. Social amenities include a residents' lounge, library, screening room with premium AV, children's playroom, private salon, and a pet-friendly dog park.

Services include a dedicated Director of Residences, Cipriani-trained concierge, 24-hour valet, in-residence spa treatments, personal training, pet grooming, and away-from-home maintenance.
description: Developed by Mast Capital with hospitality by Cipriani. 80 stories and 950 feet, currently the tallest residential tower south of New York. Topped off July 2026. 397 residences carrying four generations of Italian service, from Harry's Bar in Venice to Brickell. Over 75 percent sold.

signals.title: First ground-up Cipriani tower in the Americas
signals.body: Since Harry's Bar opened in Venice in 1931, Cipriani has built a global hospitality empire from New York to Hong Kong. This is its first ground-up residential tower in the Americas, with staff trained to Cipriani service standards.

signals.title: No hotel component, pure residential ownership
signals.body: Unlike hotel-condo hybrids, Cipriani Brickell is 100 percent residential with no transient hotel operations. Residents get the full Cipriani service standard, including 24-hour in-home dining and concierge, without guest traffic. That supports stronger governance, privacy, and long-term value.

signals.title: Mast Capital, developer of The Perigon Miami Beach
signals.body: Mast Capital developed The Perigon (OMA/Rem Koolhaas), which secured a $390M construction loan and absorbed at $2,800+/sqft. The same execution discipline carries to a more accessible price point in Brickell's most residential corridor.

signals.title: South Brickell, more residential and less transient than the core
signals.body: 1420 South Miami Avenue sits at the quieter southern end of Brickell, a block from the financial core but outside the high-traffic hotel and retail zone. Higher elevation than most Miami lots.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: At roughly $1,575 per square foot, Cipriani Residences is among the most competitively priced hospitality-branded towers in Brickell, and one of the few where the Cipriani service standard operates inside a 100 percent residential building with no hotel traffic. Mast Capital's track record at The Perigon, where a $390M construction loan and strong absorption preceded delivery, provides meaningful execution assurance. The tower topped off at 950 feet in July 2026, with more than 75 percent sold and delivery in July 2027; remaining inventory sits mostly in the upper floors and the Canaletto Collection. The South Brickell corridor is quieter and more residential than the core, a structural advantage for buyers who want proximity to the financial district without its hotel-zone density.

investmentThesis: Developed by Mast Capital with Cipriani as hospitality partner, this is the brand's first ground-up residential tower in the Americas. The tower topped off at 950 feet in July 2026, currently the tallest residential building south of New York, surpassing Panorama Tower, with delivery scheduled for July 2027 and more than 75 percent of residences already sold. Remaining inventory is concentrated in the upper floors and the Canaletto Collection. At the southern end of Brickell, the address sits a block from the financial corridor without the hotel and retail traffic of the core, a quieter and more residential position in the submarket.
name: Cipriani Residences Brickell
rentalPolicy: 2 times per year, with a minimum lease term of 30 days
residenceContent: A curved, cascading glass tower with an organic facade and nautical detailing drawn from the Italian Riviera. Residences range from one to five bedrooms plus Canaletto penthouse configurations, with 10-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling glass, expansive flow-through terraces, Italian stone flooring, custom millwork, and Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances. In-home dining and 24-hour catering by Cipriani are reserved for residents, the same service standard that runs the family's restaurants worldwide, delivered to your door on demand. The Canaletto Collection occupies the top 18 floors: 74 ultra-luxury homes, including six penthouses, with expanded floor plates, elevated finishes, and a private speakeasy.
